title: New Insight driver fails to deliver boluses
symptom: Boluses are recorded in AAPS on the phone as delivered, but the pump bolus history is empty. The animation in AAPS app was suspiciously fast (zero connection time, no sounds from the pump).
fix: Reinstalling AAPS 3.3.0.0 and restarting bluetooth resolved the issue; the bolus was finally delivered and recorded in AAPS.
evidence_quote: Retry & phone reboot did not help, but restarting bluetooth did, so the bolus was finally delivered and recorded in AAPS.
